dogecoin.text: Garlinghouse said: "I actually don't believe that Dogecoin is good for the crypto market. I guess it's a bit controversial." Garlinghouse went on to mention that he would not hold Dogecoin due to its "inflationary dynamics."

[Ripple CEO: I don’t believe Dogecoin is good for the crypto market] Golden Finance reported that Ripple CEO Brad Garlinghouse lashed out at Dogecoin during his recent attendance at a financial technology event in Abu Dhabi.
